adoption.rationale: The pinned source comment and unit cases define the deny-list predicate. Both call sites check it before making an Exchange operation and terminate with a CLI input error when it matches. Scope is limited to those characters and those two commands.

declared_domain: Formal projection: one ASCII code point tested against the literal deny-list class in the pinned Go regexp.MatchString call, with Go RE2 whitespace semantics. The product gate checks string-level MatchString behavior over all non-NUL ASCII bytes, representative control/string positions, Unicode samples, and deterministic random strings; no length bound is used. The claim covers only the listed rejected characters and the OrgCreate/OrgDel call sites.
guarantee: ValidateOrg returns true for an organization string containing an underscore, comma, Go RE2 ASCII whitespace, question mark, or apostrophe. OrgCreate and OrgDel reject such input with CLI_INPUT_ERROR before their Exchange operation. This is a deny-list guarantee only; it does not define a complete allowed-name grammar or establish URL-path safety for other characters.
input_source: The organization argument supplied to the hzn exchange org create or delete command and passed to cliutils.ValidateOrg.
